title_en: The Stance of Ibn Taymiyya and Sunni Scholars Regarding the Attributes of the Foot and Leg
description_en: The stance of Ibn Taymiyya and Sunni scholars regarding the attributes of the foot and leg for Almighty God. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: An examination of anthropomorphic descriptions such as the foot and leg attributed to God in certain texts, according to Ibn Taymiyya and Sunni scholars.
